title: Profile Verifier
tagline: Profile verifier will verify your social account using ENS Domain Name.
description: This project verifies your social media account. If you own any ENS Domain then your social account will verify. Why I am doing this. Currently, we can see many people feel that He/She account is verified because He/She is an actor, model, etc... In web3 all are equal we will give rights to all to verify the account, whoever owns the ENS domain name then their account is verified.
how_its_made: This project will use the ENS domain to verify the social media account. If any person owns an ENS domain with a minimum purchase of 2 years then his/her account is verified. We are using Figma for design. Node js, ensjs etc. Social media app will integrate Profile Verifier to verify social media user profile.
